changelog:
• New Stylized Sailboat Brand Logo: Completely replaced all launcher icons, browser brand logos, and speed-dial icons with the modern circular sailboat logo.
• Firefox-Grade Floating Single Top Bar: Eliminated double search bar and bottom navigation bar. Unified top bar with search engine selector, voice search mic, tab count badge [ 1 ], and 3-dots menu. Automatically transitions from search input to clean domain URL display when browsing.
• Real Native Voice Search: Direct speech recognition integration (RecognizerIntent) with instant search navigation and zero mock dialogs.
• Top 10 Recent Browsing History & Autocomplete: Dynamic dropdown displaying user's top 10 recent searches and visited websites with 1-tap navigation and DuckDuckGo autocomplete.
• Firefox-Style Multi-Tab Switcher: 2-column card grid with Firefox purple outline (#7C6CF6) on active tab, centered [ 🛡 You're protected ] chip, and floating purple + new tab button.
• Modernized Settings & Cards: Material 3 rounded cards (20dp radius) with dark aesthetic.
